sections.title: Getting started with the driver mobile app
sections.content:
## Download the app

### On iPhone

Search for the **OPTRANS** app on the App Store and download it. You can either open the app page or scan the QR code:

[Download OPTRANS on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/optrans/id6747156607)

![QR code to download OPTRANS on the App Store](/uploads/596352a49276e58ca9870c01.png)

### On Android, Samsung or Oppo

Search for the **OPTRANS** app on Google Play and download it. You can either open the app page or scan the QR code:

[Download OPTRANS on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=vn.vietmap.optrans.saas&pcampaignid=web_share)

![QR code to download OPTRANS on Google Play](/uploads/5b84a2190f0e686aec31391e.png)

## Signing in for the first time

1. Open the app and select **Are you a partner?**

   ![Screen for selecting partner sign-in](/uploads/4de9387bae1937c8d37ae7ff.png)

2. Enter the information you were given:

   - **Workspace:** `your site name` (for example: vantaiabc.optrans.vn --> enter "vantaiabc")
   - **Username:** `the driver's phone number`
   - **Password:** `provided by the administrator`

   Select **Remember me** so the app signs you in automatically next time.

   ![Screen for entering the workspace and sign-in details](/uploads/3549f8334cdfb9b9f516e2c1.png)

## Signing in again

Enter the phone number and password you were given, select **Remember me** if needed, then tap **Sign in**.

![Sign-in screen for subsequent sessions](/uploads/bf2dae75ec07fbb6e0bd982e.png)

## Signing out

Open the **Account management** menu and select **Sign out** to leave the app.

![Account management menu](/uploads/d617d0dec5888990cd2a8f20.png)

![Confirming sign-out from the app](/uploads/906f653ebe3fb22f5212f35a.png)

sections.title: Dispatch orders in the mobile app
sections.content:
## Home screen and today's dispatch orders

The home screen shows the dispatch orders assigned to the driver. Dispatch orders in progress appear at the top so the driver can continue working right after signing in.

![Home screen with today's dispatch orders](/uploads/12d563f0377ff6a3807b5630.png)

## New dispatch orders

There are two ways for a driver to accept a dispatch order in the mobile app:

* Option 1: On the In progress screen, find the dispatch order with the **Accept** status and tap **Accept** to start the trip.

![List showing a new dispatch order awaiting confirmation](/uploads/82c4216ce5beab47b70084c5.png)

* Option 2: On the **Details** screen, review the dispatch order information before accepting it.

![Accepting a dispatch order](/uploads/5dc2574b0d042aa7e07f3b7b.png)
![Confirming the dispatch order](/uploads/c46af77573c83b38c1ed1b3d.png)

* Once the dispatch order is accepted, the system updates its status to **Accepted**. The driver can then start the remaining tasks.

![Dispatch order accepted](/uploads/bc9e24ceadd8419c50ff27c9.png)

## Filtering dispatch orders by status

The filters on the status bar are:

- **In progress:** dispatch orders that are **In progress**, **Awaiting confirmation**, or **Accepted by driver**.
- **Completed:** dispatch orders that are **Completed**.
- **Suspended:** dispatch orders that are **Suspended** because of an incident.
- **Canceled:** dispatch orders that have been canceled.

![Filtering dispatch orders by status](/uploads/494921b0b19adda6c1c1bf58.png)

![Dispatch order statuses](/uploads/5365dc0c134625e7c96d0b53.png)

## Viewing past dispatch orders

1. Tap the calendar area at the top of the screen.

   ![Opening the dispatch order history picker](/uploads/237466b13534bf6c4d4e3287.png)

2. Select a start date and an end date. The app highlights the selected range in green; you can change it before confirming.
3. Select **OK** to search. Select **Clear** then **OK** to remove the date range, or **Cancel** to close the picker. If you do not select any date, the system uses the current date.

   ![Selecting a date range for the history](/uploads/f866926e318aeb9a12d7b78d.png)

4. The results show the dispatch orders and tasks within the selected date range.

   ![Dispatch order history search results](/uploads/d82c94055d3e857e2ed0c940.png)

## Viewing the task list quickly

1. Tap anywhere on a dispatch order.
2. The system opens the dispatch order details page and shows the task list.
3. Tap each task to see its details.

![Opening dispatch order details](/uploads/bdd7a75b6a2f8a52542552dc.png)

![Task list within a dispatch order](/uploads/fabaabbbfa5e44e504b77985.png)

![Details of a single task](/uploads/16ce079d475060d08e626025.png)

## Viewing task locations on the map

On the task details screen, select **Directions**. The app switches to the map tab and shows the task locations for the dispatch order.

![Directions button on the task details screen](/uploads/e0a78290a6c1199957387c5a.png)

![Task locations on the map](/uploads/de84229afd72d8f8bcfbfe8f.png)

sections.title: Performing tasks in the mobile app
sections.content:
## Starting a task

* Select a dispatch order on the home screen.
* For each task, select **Start**. The task moves to **Accepted** and shows the **Perform** button. The status is also synchronized with the dispatcher's web system.

![Selecting a dispatch order to work on](/uploads/80612b4bc0c5783c7c13486e.png)

## Dispatch order details screen
* After accepting the dispatch order, the driver starts the tasks from the dispatch order details screen.

![Dispatch order details and task list](/uploads/a501885284d9d4b75b0cc815.png)

* Tap the Start button on the task you want to perform, such as Pick up empty container, Drop off empty container or Pick up laden container.

![Start button on a task](/uploads/bd8e5e8e3080371fd2bba0e4.png)

![Task in progress](/uploads/4b653e7c9aed7e4d16de1566.png)


## Viewing attached document images

On the details screen of a dispatch order, tap the icon under **Open documents** to view the related documents.

![Open documents](/uploads/37a3d4f84a14d90ed33c1dcd.png)

There are two groups of documents:
- Order documents
- Dispatch order documents

### Viewing order documents

Select the **Order** tab to view documents related to the current order, including:
- Bookings and documents belonging to the order

![Documents as files](/uploads/53dd4d171870805f3edf23f9.png)

- Documents and notes related to the waybill or container (for example the container pickup code or invoicing details)

![Documents as notes](/uploads/45b2b1fbecd236507e4b97e7.png)

**NOTE:** Select **Hide items without documents** so the app only shows items that have an attachment or a note.

![Hiding items without documents](/uploads/aa4d525efcb4198c4d6e9200.png)

### Viewing dispatch order documents

Select the **Dispatch order** tab to view documents related to the current dispatch order, including:
- Images and documents related to the dispatch order that the driver or the dispatcher uploaded to the system

![Dispatch order documents](/uploads/a5d18c63f59fca51b41f2bd5.png)

**NOTE:** Select **Hide items without documents** so the app only shows items that have an attachment or a note.

![Hiding items without documents](/uploads/62af6195ee1fe6ad4c027693.png)

### Sharing documents and images with other apps

Select the checkbox for each file or image you want to share, then tap **Share**.

![Selecting items to share](/uploads/63916c7625143f9bc8f1c95d.png)

Then choose the app you want to share the selected items with.

![Choosing an app](/uploads/ea59e539812d3f3f4b8830ad.png)

## Updating task information

When you arrive at the task location, select **Perform** to open the task popup.

![Task popup](/uploads/4b653e7c9aed7e4d16de1566.png)

### Updating the container and seal numbers

* The system shows the task list. The driver needs to record the container and seal numbers.
* Tap **Enter container** or **Enter seal** to record the container number and the seal number.

![Entering the container number](/uploads/9bf21fd35c195705775e5fea.png)

![Entering the seal number](/uploads/a40f031f51dfe6427501115d.png)

![Scanning the container number](/uploads/348cba6bf53eb092c615ce16.png)

* The system records the container and seal numbers successfully.

![Scanning the seal number](/uploads/ea0c93d8943e61577abf18c0.png)

### Updating images and documents

Select the option to add an image or document, take a photo or pick an existing one, review the preview, and upload it to the task.

![Choosing the image or document type](/uploads/329463b111cac2e0e6ff4c28.png)

![Photographing a document](/uploads/ce0523a439a47bcb356f76ed.png)

**Note**: The driver must upload the required number of images for every item labeled (Required) before the dispatch order can be completed. If any required item is missing an image, the system will not allow the driver to complete the dispatch order.

![Document preview](/uploads/df6f6d19e1ea1728b1140441.png)

## Completing a task

Once all the work is done, select **Complete**.

![Complete button on a task](/uploads/c80378c470d47caf50907f15.png)

The system updates the first task to the **Completed** status.

![Task completed](/uploads/a08fa14e9597b9ea4c1311c6.png)

## Reporting an incident

If an accident or incident forces the driver to pause the trip or makes it impossible to continue, select the warning icon.

1. Select a reason, enter a description and tap **Send**.
2. On the confirmation screen, tap **OK**.
3. The dispatch order moves to **Suspended**. In the web system the dispatch order moves to **Incident**, and the details are stored in the **Incident history** tab.

![Incident reporting icon](/uploads/db8e6f4c8bc1b2a434b3ec3f.png)

![Selecting an incident reason](/uploads/d13c876f0cc1c35614f54a58.png)

![Entering an incident description](/uploads/3130f6439ec8a9431164e931.png)

![Confirming the incident report](/uploads/015dfdec27b21ee11f8ffa09.png)

![Dispatch order suspended after the report](/uploads/dd79a6f0d70cc50255eee44e.png)

sections.title: Additional expenses in the mobile app
sections.content:
## Creating an additional expense

While working on a dispatch order, the driver can quickly record additional expenses to keep track of them and send them to the dispatcher for approval.

* From the dispatch order list or details, select the correct dispatch order, then select **Create record**.

![Opening the expense creation function](/uploads/616f09776ce65d704b3488f9.png)

* The app shows the expense entry screen.

![Expense entry screen](/uploads/92bec7871151d4293252578e.png)

* Select the type of expense to create.
* Select the location where the expense occurred if the expense type requires one. If it is not required, you can skip it.
* Enter the amount and a **Description** if needed.

![Entering the amount and description](/uploads/b2d01928b3689fa6dedeadb1.png)

* Select **Create expense**, then confirm the creation.

![Confirming expense creation](/uploads/0175f6ec6cfa1868fac6aa13.png)

## Viewing the expenses you created

* Open the **User management** menu.

![User management menu](/uploads/d617d0dec5888990cd2a8f20.png)

* Select **Additional expenses**.

 ![Opening the additional expense list](/uploads/2076e1d355619163aaab1e64.png)

**Note**: The expense list is grouped by processing status.
* Use the filters to find the expenses you need.

![Expense statuses](/uploads/6197bef735283a2e1758f896.png)

![Expense filters](/uploads/956de888dc260f19a320aed5.png)

![Expense status filter](/uploads/2d24ba8c335380bf0077ae86.png)

sections.title: Leave and notifications in the mobile app
sections.content:
## Creating a leave request

1. Open the **User management** menu.

![User management menu](/uploads/d617d0dec5888990cd2a8f20.png)

2. Select **Leave**.

![Opening the leave function](/uploads/03bf26064e45f1939516cc10.png)

3. Enter a reason and select the leave dates.

![Entering a leave reason](/uploads/8bda0a1c57ea5c776f6e5553.png)

![Selecting a leave date range](/uploads/9b5acdb55b3b7b91c37c3b25.png)

![Leave date picker](/uploads/6a3589d6e020cc0f83ee2f6f.png)

4. Review the list of requests and their processing status.

![Leave request list and statuses](/uploads/9fb9f005ca23db7f4d91dafa.png)

## Viewing notifications

When a new dispatch order arrives, or when a dispatch order, task, expense, or leave request is updated, the system sends a notification to the phone. Tap the bell icon to review the list.

![Notification list](/uploads/e2da612260155eef7198bdcf.png)

sections.title: Account and support in the mobile app
sections.content:
## Viewing support information

1. Open the **User management** menu.
2. Select **Settings** to see the available settings.

![Account settings screen](/uploads/6e7ed9b6338c93cd6caa3cff.png)

3. Select **Contact** to see the support contact details.

![Support contact details](/uploads/409f19a604c961b824770eae.png)

## Changing your password

1. Open the **User management** menu.
2. Select **Settings**.
3. Select **Account**.

![Account screen within settings](/uploads/6e7ed9b6338c93cd6caa3cff.png)

4. Select **Change password** and follow the instructions in the app.

![Account](/uploads/24aaf474cb9af7d3f39cc97f.png)

![Change password screen](/uploads/7d4102cc84fdc2fde82882d2.png)

![Password change details](/uploads/2e8d95fcb5f919e978621a69.png)
